info.description:
🚀 **Enterprise-Grade E-commerce API Collection**

**Super Admin Account:**
- Email: romeomukulah@gmail.com
- ID: c429e249-c897-496a-8da8-12bc5209f609

**Quick Start:**
1. Import this collection
2. Import the Development environment
3. Run '01. Login Super Admin' in 🔐 Authentication folder
4. Token auto-saves - start testing!

**New Features in v2.0:**
✨ Product & Category Media (Images/Videos with auto-optimization)
✨ Product & Category Collections
✨ Create Products with Media in single request
✨ Admin Management with Invitations

**API Features:**
- JWT Authentication
- Role-Based Access Control (super_admin, admin, customer)
- Image Optimization (WebP, 4 sizes)
- Video Support (MP4, up to 100MB)
- Collections with Scheduling
- Comprehensive Error Handling
